{{Top|leg}}
The '''Tapani Parliament''' was the initial legislative body formed following the fall of the [[Tapani Empire]]. It elected the first [[Prime Minister (Tapani Federation)|Prime Minister]] of the [[Tapani Federation]] in 11,139 (Tapani calendar).

The position of Prime Minister was later selected by majority vote in the [[Great Council (Tapani Federation)|Great Council]].
